Biography

DFIR Specialist with extensive experience building and leading incident response capabilities across government, military, law enforcement, finance, and MSSP environments. He specializes in digital forensics, threat investigations, malware analysis, and incident containment, using advanced forensic tools and chip-off techniques. Eli has served as a DFIR Lead, cybersecurity consultant, and community contributor to Red Canary’s Atomic Red Team. He provides organizations with end-to-end DFIR solutions—from policy development and infrastructure setup to active threat response—ensuring resilience, reduced downtime, and strengthened cyber preparedness. He holds multiple industry certifications, including Fortinet, Linux, and cybersecurity analyst credentials, and has a strong technical foundation in Wireshark, Scapy, and PowerShell.
